rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something puzzling or not readily accounted for.

example.english: They suddenly said they wanted to quit; it was inexplicable.
example.traditional: 佢無啦啦話要辭職，真係莫名其妙。
example.jyutping: keoi5 mou4 laa1 laa1 waa6 jiu3 ci4 zik1 zan1 hai6 mok6 ming4 kei4 miu6

rows.note: Use this when you want to say literally that the situation cannot be explained.

example.english: I really can't explain why the phone turned on by itself; it is inexplicable.
example.traditional: 點解部手機自己著咗，我真係解釋唔到。
example.jyutping: dim2 gaai2 bou6 sau2 gei1 zi6 gei2 zoek3 zo2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gaai2 sik1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this mainly for something so baffling or extraordinary that it seems inexplicable, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: The results of this experiment are inexplicable.
example.traditional: 呢項實驗嘅結果令人覺得不可思議。
example.jyutping: ne1 hong6 sat6 jim6 ge3 git3 gwo2 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 bat1 ho2 si1 ji5
